health.title: Xentree Connect health check
health.clock.warning: Offset %{ms} ms (±%{unc} ms) via %{source}; positive means this clock is behind. Assertions are offset-corrected, but fix NTP when you can.
health.clock.critical: Offset %{ms} ms (±%{unc} ms) via %{source}. Launch assertions will likely be rejected; fix NTP on this host.
health.key.none: No key specified and none found in the default locations.
health.key.invalid: %{path} is not a valid ES256 private key.
health.key.kid_mismatch: Key id %{kid} differs from the one in the config (%{expected}); the registered JWKS may be stale.
health.api.skipped: No admin token (set XENTREE_ADMIN_TOKEN); skipping the API check.
health.api.unauthorized: Reached %{url} but the admin token was rejected.

init.title: Xentree Connect setup
init.prompt.name: Integration name
init.prompt.auto_enroll: Automatically assign a seat to consenting users? (consumes seats)
init.clock.ok: Clock is in sync (offset %{ms} ms, ±%{unc} ms).
init.clock.warn: Clock offset is %{ms} ms (±%{unc} ms). Assertions will be offset-corrected, but fix NTP when you can.
init.clock.high: Clock offset is %{ms} ms (±%{unc} ms), which is large. Launch assertions may be rejected until the clock is fixed.
init.clock.unavailable: Could not measure the clock (%{error}); continuing.
init.token.help: Input is hidden. You can also set XENTREE_ADMIN_TOKEN.
init.token.missing: No admin token: set XENTREE_ADMIN_TOKEN (required with --yes).
init.orgs.none: This token administers no organizations; only organization admins can register Connect integrations.
init.orgs.not_found: Organization %{org} is not among those this token administers.
init.err.issuer_required: An issuer URL is required; pass --issuer.
init.err.no_key_dir: Cannot determine a directory for the key; pass --key-dir.
init.key.location: Private key will be stored at: %{path}
init.key.group_missing: No web-server group found (%{groups}); the key will be readable by the current user only.
init.key.confirm: Use this location and these permissions?
init.error.key_exists: A key already exists at %{path}. Use --reuse-key to register it, or choose another --key-dir.
init.error.register_failed:
Registration failed: %{error}
The private key was kept at %{path}. Fix the problem and re-run with --reuse-key.
init.error.client_id_taken: The client ID %{client_id} is already taken; choose another with --client-id.
init.generating: Generating an ES256 keypair and registering the integration…
init.reusing: Registering the integration with the existing key…
init.done.title: Xentree Connect is set up.
init.warn.config_not_saved:
The integration is registered, but %{path} could not be written: %{error}
Note your record ID: %{id}
init.next.title: Next steps
init.next.sign: Sign launch assertions with ES256, kid %{kid}, lifetime of 60 seconds at most. Never share the private key.
init.next.health: Run `xentree-connect health` to verify the clock, key permissions and API access.
init.next.webhook: Register a webhook through the Xentree admin API to receive learning events.
init.next.group: Check that the web server user belongs to the group that can read the key.
gateway.warn.flag_secret: Warning: the gateway secret was passed as a flag and is visible in the process list. Prefer XENTREE_GATEWAY_SECRET.
gateway.warn.internal_exposed: Warning: the internal listener is bound to %{addr}, which is not loopback. Restrict it to a private network and a firewall.
gateway.warn.query_secret: Warning: --allow-query-secret lets the secret travel in URLs, which end up in logs, history and Referer headers.
gateway.warn.trusted_headers: Warning: trusting identity from headers (%{names}). Only safe behind a proxy that strips them from client requests and sets them itself.
gateway.warn.no_webhook: No webhook secret configured: /webhook will answer 503. Set XENTREE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
gateway.warn.no_tls: The gateway speaks plain HTTP. Put it behind a TLS-terminating proxy before exposing it.
gateway.error.secret_missing: A gateway secret is required: set XENTREE_GATEWAY_SECRET (at least 32 characters, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`).
gateway.error.secret_short: The gateway secret must be at least %{min} characters.
gateway.error.config: Could not load the config (run `xentree-connect init` first, or pass --config).
gateway.error.previous_without_active: A previous webhook secret was given without the active one.
